extensionDescription.message: Limit the maximum decibel level in a browser tab

mainToggleTitle.description: Title for the main toggle button

enhancedModeDesc.message: Enables direct tab audio capture so the extension can measure average decibels and apply limiting on pages that block normal audio capture. May request additional permissions.

enhancedModeMuted.message: Note: while active, the browser may prevent entering fullscreen automatically on some pages — you may need to press F11 manually.
enhancedModeMuted.description: Short note for enhanced mode about fullscreen impact

closeLabel.description: Label for close button on info panel

floorTooltip.message: Minimum gain during a peak. Lower = more aggressive limiting.

releaseTooltip.message: How fast volume recovers after a peak. Lower = slower recovery.

footer.message: Control the volume of your navigation tabs

gainLabel.description: Label for the live applied-gain readout

applyAllSitesLabel.description: Label for the global (all-sites) persistence toggle

applyAllSitesTooltip.message: Keeps this exact limiter setting active on every site/tab you open (saved persistently), instead of per-tab only.
applyAllSitesTooltip.description: Tooltip explaining the global persistence toggle

coachmarkIntro.description: Text for the what's-new tour's intro screen

coachmarkStart.description: Button to start the what's-new tour from the intro

coachmarkPresets.message: New: pick the limiter's strength with a preset.
coachmarkPresets.description: Step 1 of the what's-new tour, points at the preset selector

coachmarkGlobalToggle.message: New: turn this on to apply the same setting to every site.
coachmarkGlobalToggle.description: Step 2 of the what's-new tour, points at the global toggle

coachmarkNext.description: Button to advance to the next tour step

coachmarkDone.description: Button to dismiss the tour on the last step
